combo_label: Jobs & Professions × Musical Instruments × Ancient Rome

entries.clue: Small Italian stream whose crossing meant the die was cast
First through the door with a defibrillator after the blue-light dash
Six strings over a waisted wooden body, strummed at every campfire
Tamps the grounds, steams the milk and draws a leaf in your flat white
God of the vine whose festivals got notoriously out of hand
Flat Alpine soundboard, many taut strings, laid on a table and plucked
City whose victims survive as plaster casts of the hollows they left
Thin cane sliver that buzzes against a mouthpiece to start the sound
Playground truce cry that once named an empire-wide calm
Runs the pass in starched whites, tasting every plate before it goes out
Shallow drum with rattling wires beneath, giving a marching beat its crack
